Version: 5.9

serialize

Callable

  • serialize<T, P>(entity, options): EntityDTO<Loaded<T, P>>
  • serialize<T, P>(entities, options): EntityDTO<Loaded<T, P>>[]

  • Converts entity instance to POJO, converting the Collections to arrays and unwrapping the Reference wrapper, while respecting the serialization options.

    Type parameters

    • T: object
    • P: string = never

    Parameters

    • entity: T
    • optionaloptions: SerializeOptions<T, P>

    Returns EntityDTO<Loaded<T, P>>
